annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that the server must set the negotiated_version field to the version value from the Initial packet it accepts, explicitly excluding any Initial packet that triggers a Retry or Version Negotiation packet. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
